info.name: GePG Bridge - GePG callbacks (GePG to the bridge)
info.description: What GePG posts to the bridge, with the bridge's possible answers saved on each request. The samples use the placeholder signature, so the bridge answers 7303 until the sig_ variables hold real signatures (see GePG_Callbacks_Guide.md).

item.name: Bill submission response
item.description:
GePG has processed a bill the bridge submitted, and gives the control number or the reason it refused.

The bridge stores the control number (or the rejection) on the bill and tells the billing system that owns it.

exec: pm.test('The bridge answered with an acknowledgement', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('<AckStsCode>'));

response.name: 7101 Received and recorded. GePG need not send it again.

originalRequest.description: Bill accepted. Spec section 4.2.2.2.

item.name: Payment notification
item.description:
A payer has paid a control number through a bank or mobile network.

The bridge records each payment (a repeat of the same TrxId is ignored), marks the bill paid once the payments cover it, and tells the owning billing system.

item.name: Successful payments summary (reconciliation response)
item.description:
GePG answers a reconciliation request with the day's successful payments.

The bridge saves the list and records any payment it did not already have (for example one whose notification was lost), then tells the owning billing system.

exec: pm.test('The bridge answered with an acknowledgement', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('<AckStsCode>'));
